international.notes: No official evidence was found that a Medicine subject is delivered in English. The published Medicine curriculum includes Inglés I–IV, which does not establish English-medium medical teaching. The Dirección de Cooperación Internacional manages international links; the university also has mobility and international-agreement activity.

profile_paragraphs: Medicine is organised as the Escuela de Medicina, rather than a Faculty of Medicine. It is a unit under UMAG’s Academic Vice-Rectorate; Mario Mayanz Csato is listed as its director. The published programme leads to Médico/a Cirujano/a and Licenciado/a en Medicina.

The programme is on-site in Punta Arenas and lasts 14 semesters. The 2022 CNA decision refers to the 2014 and 2015 graduating cohorts and granted a four-year accreditation from 17 August 2022; UMAG’s current quality page records its subsequent accreditation process.

Clinical training is closely tied to Hospital Clínico de Magallanes. UMAG and the hospital marked 50 years of their teaching-care alliance in 2025, and the Medicine accreditation decision confirms teaching-service agreements for clinical placements and internships.

For a rheumatologist, the affiliated Hospital Clínico de Magallanes has a named Unidad de Reumatología in its current medical organigram. UMAG has not evidenced an operating rheumatology specialty programme; its own 2026 account frames medical-specialty programmes as a progressive future development.

The medical unit is an Escuela and has a director, not a dean; consequently there is no current dean to report.
No dedicated official page for external academic concursos was found. The official HR page was readable but had no active academic vacancy list on 3 September 2026.
